title: Открытое окно
author: Hector Hugh Munro (Saki), 1870–1916
first_publication: 18 November 1911, Westminster Gazette; reprinted in Beasts and Super-Beasts (1914)
evidence: Project Gutenberg identifies Saki (1870–1916), the 1914 collection and the story's text; its author note says The Open Window first appeared in the Westminster Gazette. The Annotated Saki bibliography dates first publication to 18 November 1911.

rights_assessment.us: Project Gutenberg marks the 1914 collection as public domain in the USA.
rights_assessment.eu_eea: Saki died in 1916. Under EU Directive 2006/116/EC Article 1(1), the ordinary author term is life plus 70 years; on the supplied author/death evidence, the term expired at the end of 1986. The story's earlier 1911 newspaper publication is also documented.
rights_assessment.germany: German UrhG §64 provides life plus 70 years; Saki died in 1916, so protection expired 31 December 1986.
rights_assessment.translations: No modern third-party Russian translation is reused. This Russian text is a new independent translation prepared for BookCheef.
rights_assessment.illustrations: The source story is text-only in the consulted edition. The BookCheef cover and two in-book illustrations are newly authored SVG artwork.

attribution: H. H. Munro (Saki), “The Open Window,” first published 1911; collected in Beasts and Super-Beasts (1914). New Russian translation and original illustrations for BookCheef.
scope: Commercial digital publication in the USA and EU/EEA based on cited publication and author-death evidence; not a worldwide legal opinion.
review_notes: Original story was checked in Project Gutenberg's transcription of the 1914 edition.
